_comment: Japan Ministry of Finance / Customs trade statistics. Everything here is
keyless: static files on customs.go.jp plus e-Stat's public CSV downloads.
Verified 2026-09-02 (customs.go.jp is unreachable from the build sandbox;
file existence was checked through an external fetcher, and the first
GitHub Actions run captures the payloads under data/japan/raw/).
Release cadence (calendar: https://www.customs.go.jp/toukei/calendar/calend_e.htm):
first 10 days  -> ~28th of the same month, 08:50 JST (press release XML)
first 20 days  -> ~7th of the next month, 08:50 JST (press release XML)
monthly prov.  -> ~20th of the next month, 08:50 JST (press release XML + PDF)
detailed (D&P) -> end of the next month, 09:30 JST (XML + PDF, e-Stat CSVs)
Press-release XML file naming, verified by probing existing files:
trade-st_e/<YYYY>/<YYYYMM><stage>e.xml  (English; Japanese: trade-st/<YYYY>/<YYYYMM><stage>.xml)
stage 1 = first 10 days, 2 = first 20 days, 4 = monthly provisional,
5 = exports detailed / imports 9-digit provisional. 3 does not exist.
e.g. 2026081e.xml (Aug 2026 first 10 days), 2026064e.xml (Jun 2026 monthly).
Keyless CSV time series (thousand yen) under toukei/suii/html/data/.
d41ma.csv is confirmed as the world monthly export/import total from 1979
(used by third-party packages). d51ma.csv and d61ma.csv exist and are the
candidates for the monthly principal-commodity series (exports/imports,
from 1988); the first capture run settles which is which. Index pages:
https://www.customs.go.jp/toukei/suii/html/time_e.htm (area totals),
https://www.customs.go.jp/toukei/suii/html/time.htm (adds 主要商品別).
e-Stat hosts MOF's monthly CSV tables without a key. 統計品別表 (Values by
Commodity) gives value and quantity per 9-digit statistical code for the
world, one file per month (each file carries Jan..latest of its year).
Listing pages (HTML) carry links of the form
stat-search/file-download?statInfId=<12 digits>&fileKind=1
CSV columns (confirmed from a consumer of these files):
Exp or Imp,Year,HS,Unit1,Unit2,Quantity1-Year,Quantity2-Year,Value-Year,
Quantity1-Jan,Quantity2-Jan,Value-Jan,...,Value-Dec  (value = thousand yen)
tclass2 000001013185 = imports (confirmed); 000001013184 = exports (inferred).

hs_codes._comment: Prefixes matched against the 9-digit statistical code (dots removed). Supply side of the AI build-out: equipment, materials, optics.
hs_codes.8486: Semiconductor / flat-panel manufacturing machinery (Tokyo Electron, Screen, Kokusai, Lasertec, Disco)
hs_codes.8541: Diodes, transistors, photosensitive devices incl. laser diodes and photodiodes
hs_codes.9001: Optical fibres, bundles, cables and optical elements (Sumitomo Electric, Fujikura, Furukawa)
hs_codes.9013: Optical devices and instruments incl. lasers other than laser diodes
hs_codes.3818: Doped chemical elements / wafers for electronics (Shin-Etsu, SUMCO)
